$comment: Interactive sessions in this repo. The autonomous loop does NOT rely on this file:
scripts/core/auto-loop.sh passes loop-settings.json via --settings, which carries the
sandbox, deny rules and the Bash guard hook.
The upstream 'allow' list was removed: allow rules have no effect under bypassPermissions,
so it granted nothing while looking like it did.
enableAllProjectMcpServers is false so that trusting this workspace never auto-starts an
MCP server a future upstream merge might add.
